When a caller asks for an estimate, create a job in the CRM with the following structure:

- Title: Brief summary of the job.

- Description: Scope of work, surfaces, access notes, and the timing the caller asked for.

- Photos/Measurements: Include any photos or measurements the caller provided.

- Customer Reference: Mention the customer by name and phone number.

- Additional Tags: Include urgency, crew size, or neighbourhood tags if relevant.
